name: clipy-record
description: A Record button above the prompt: show Claude your screen and talk it through, press stop, and Claude reads the recording (transcript, key moments, screenshots) and gets to work.

clipyCommand.title: Clipy command
clipyCommand.description: How to run the Clipy CLI. Leave empty to use clipy from your PATH, or give a full command such as node /path/to/cli/dist/index.js.

maxMinutes.title: Longest recording (minutes)
maxMinutes.description: The recording stops by itself after this long, up to 29 minutes.
